title: DDGS 2.0.1
release_notes:
- The Assistant: an agent that searches, fetches, saves, downloads and schedules for you, asking once before it writes
- 50 credits a day with a receipt on every reply; Premium raises it to 500 a day and removes ads
- Expandable reasoning and a live model catalog with rate hints
- Fix: the Assistant screen scrolls and keeps its composer at the bottom on phones
